name: emcc
description: EMCC (Every Mod Claude Code): a curated, tested collection of Claude Code mods.

plugins.name: emcc-core
plugins.description: EMCC's shared base: the $.emcc noun (evidence, badges, profile, kill switch) and one status band above the prompt.

plugins.name: goalpost-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from passing a check by lowering the bar: weakened or deleted tests, new suppressions, relaxed config, softened CI, lowered coverage, skipped git hooks.

plugins.name: witness
plugins.description: A live view of Claude's work: the goal, a ribbon of its time, what it is doing now, and each step marked proven, unproven, stale or flagged.

plugins.name: headspace
plugins.description: What Claude carries, in colour: a bar above the prompt with system, rules, conversation and large tool results, and a pane to turn rules off for the session, edit and save them, and take out large results.

plugins.name: headspace-cut
plugins.description: headspace's companion: answers the compactions headspace starts, replacing the marked tool results with one line each and summarizing nothing.
